review.intent_summary: Callers can supply a season length; ordered values without one can use conservative season inference with a lag-one fallback.

criteria.criterion: An explicit season length is honored and reported as explicit.
A repeating positional series can infer a seasonal lag and report the selection window.
A positional series without a sufficiently stable candidate falls back to lag one and records why.
The reserved calibration and evaluation tail does not determine positional season selection.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected positional-season: lag 7, selection window [0,27], ranked candidates, strength criteria, and separate confirmation candidates; domain confirmation remains a stated interpretation limit.
